none: PAS NLM-11DDE7: Roman Coin, Radiate, possibly of Postumus, from Belton
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, possibly of Postumus (260-269), Reece period 13, cf Cunetio no 2453 but chipped and without legend starting in left field. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP[---]T[---]. Reverse description: Pax standing left with vertical sceptre and branch held aloft. Reverse inscription: [P]AX[AVG]. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 6
